bullets.text: Massive Flight Simulator Update - Sim Update 5 unlocks all career modes for players in **Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024**.
Windows Insider Enhancements - New features improve navigation and control for **Windows Insiders** in the latest update.
Critical Linux Vulnerability Alert - **Microsoft Defender** identifies a high-severity privilege escalation flaw affecting major Linux distributions.
New Windows Insider Builds - Latest builds released for **Windows 11** Insiders, enhancing user experience and ISO support.
Agent 365 Launches - **Microsoft Agent 365** now available, offering governance and security for AI agents across environments.
Xbox Mode for Gamers - **Windows 11** introduces Xbox mode, enhancing gaming experience with a streamlined interface.
Open-Sourcing Azure HSM - **Microsoft** commits to transparency by open-sourcing the Azure Integrated HSM for better security.
Email Threat Trends - **Microsoft Threat Intelligence** reports rising phishing attacks, with QR code phishing emerging as a key vector.
CISO Best Practices - **Microsoft** shares essential strategies for CISOs to conduct effective risk reviews in cybersecurity.
AI-Driven Business Growth - **Microsoft** emphasizes the role of AI in transforming businesses and enhancing operational efficiency.
